message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: Defendant bought 150 kg of bulk salt, knew it might be non-conforming, used it to process tea eggs sold to consumers. The salt lacked iodine (0 I), not meeting GB5416-2000 standard for refined salt grade II. In iodine-deficient area, regulations require iodized salt for food. So using non-iodized salt is illegal. Likely crime: "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品" (production and sale of food not meeting safety standards). In examples, similar case: selling industrial salt as food, they labeled as "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". Also earlier example: selling industrial salt as food was "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". So answer: [罪名]生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品<eoa>.
